headline.purpose: Section h2 and area names on the destination board.

title.purpose: h3 on cards, board rows and side-column headings.

numeral.purpose: Floor numbers on the directory board and lift indicator. 125% width, 300, tabular.

lede.purpose: One paragraph under a heading, 44 to 52ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase field labels, board column heads and frame captions. Never a kicker above a heading.

shadows.name: lit-edge
shadows.purpose: Focused band-form cell or field: a lit underline, not elevation. The system has no drop shadows.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Arrow nudge on board rows (0.35s) and FAQ toggle rotation (0.3s).

motion.name: state-colour
motion.purpose: Colour, border and background transitions on plates, fields and board rows (chips 0.2s).

motion.name: lift-floor-step
motion.value: view-timeline per main section after the first; animation-range: entry 60% entry 100%; fill forwards
motion.purpose: Steps the registered integer --floor (counter style G,1..7). Name/fill and timeline/range live in separate rules so the minifier cannot fold animation-timeline into the shorthand. Gated by @supports (animation-timeline: view()) and prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; pages passing --floor-at (service pages) pin a static floor.

motion.name: wa-plate-in
motion.purpose: Floating WhatsApp plate appears after the hero on pages with a hero.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, transitions collapse, smooth scroll is off, and the lift rests at G or its fixed floor.

narrative.overview:
The site is the ground-floor lobby of a premium residential tower: a black stone wall, slightly lighter slabs set into it, steel hairline joints between them, brushed-silver lettering, and a single kind of light, the blue of a lift indicator and a lit call button. Every page is a room in the same lobby. Services are read off a directory board as floors; areas are read off a destination board; renders hang as framed display panels with a caption plate.

Density is calm and architectural: generous section padding, one wrap width, and content held on slabs rather than floating on the wall. Depth comes from tone (stone, slab, slab-hi) and hairlines, never shadows. Motion is limited to the lift indicator stepping floors with scroll, colour changes on hover, and a small arrow nudge on board rows.

The world replaced an earlier blue-hour / wide-caps direction. What carries over is only what the owner pinned: black ground, electric blue, silver, and the V mark. The swoosh lives in the logo only; the wall carries no gradients, glows or swooshes.
keyCharacteristics: Black stone ground with slabs joined by 1px steel hairlines.
Silver lettering in Archivo Variable, mixed case, width as the expressive axis.
Blue only as a lit signal.
Flat 4px call-plate buttons that light blue when pressed.
Directory boards, display frames and a lift indicator as the signature furniture.

rules.name: The Lit Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue is light, not paint. It appears on the lift LED, on the primary call plate, on focus, and on hover/active/checked state. Text, backgrounds, rules and illustrations at rest stay stone and silver.

rules.name: The One Call Plate Rule
rules.body: A view carries one blue-filled plate at rest; every other action is a slab plate that lights only when pressed.

rules.name: The Width Is the Voice Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by width and size, not by caps or tracking. Headings are mixed case with tight negative tracking (-0.025em); wide tracked caps are reserved for the VEYLO / MEDIA wordmark lockup beside the V mark.

rules.name: The Label Is Not a Kicker Rule
rules.body: Small uppercase labels name a field, a column or a picture. They never sit above a heading as an eyebrow.

rules.name: The Hairline Joint Rule
rules.body: Surfaces meet at 1px steel lines. Never separate them with shadow, gradient or glow.

dos: **Do** build every surface from stone, slab and 1px steel hairlines, with `steel-hi` on a slab's outer edge.
**Do** set headings in Archivo at 112% width, weight 500, mixed case, -0.025em; set numbers at 125% width, weight 300, tabular.
**Do** keep one call-plate-blue action per view; every other action is a slab plate that lights blue on `:active`.
**Do** show demonstration imagery only inside a display frame with a "Sample" caption plate.
**Do** present lists of services or places as boards on a slab with hairline rows, not as card grids.
**Do** gate any scroll-driven motion behind `@supports` and `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`, with a meaningful static state.
donts: **Don't** use blue as decoration, body colour or background at rest; it is the lit signal only.
**Don't** add drop shadows, gradients, glows or swooshes to the wall; the swoosh lives only in the logo.
**Don't** set headings in wide tracked caps; that treatment belongs to the wordmark alone.
**Don't** put uppercase labels above headings as kickers or eyebrows.
**Don't** merge the lift indicator's `animation-timeline` back into the `animation` shorthand rule.
